advisories.description: Whatever is worth saying. An empty array is a valid and often correct answer.

note.description: The remark itself, in one or two sentences.

why_it_matters.description: Why this is worth the reader's attention right now.

evidence.description: A concrete anchor if you have one: file:line, a command, an observed output. Empty string if not applicable.

confidence.description: Your own confidence that this remark is correct and worth making.
